@graph.name: Canban
@graph.description: Official website for Canban — the open-source native macOS and Linux Kanban & terminal workbench for AI coding agents (Canban = Kanban + Workflow + Herdr).

@graph.name: Canban
@graph.applicationSubCategory: AI Coding Agent Kanban & Native Terminal Workbench
@graph.softwareRequirements: git, Herdr Core (hc), GTK4 runtime on Linux desktop, and any native Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity agy, Pi, Cursor CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode)
@graph.description: Canban is an open-source native macOS and Linux Kanban and terminal workbench built in Rust that unifies flexible Kanban cards, a global Attention Inbox, GitHub Actions-like Workflows with isolated Git worktrees and FIFO Queue Merge, inline Git diff review, and Herdr persistent PTY terminals across local and remote Linux canband hosts.
featureList: Flexible Kanban board with Markdown specs, #Card links, screenshots, @Agent discussions, isolated per-card Git worktrees, and GitHub Issue/PR sync
GitHub Actions-like YAML workflows & Visual Studio with shell scripts, agent + prompt steps, cron schedules, and serialized FIFO Queue Merge
Global Attention Inbox (⌘I) across all projects, terminals, and remote hosts with one-click jump to Card and live TTY
Native Agent CLI support in persistent Herdr PTY terminals (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity agy, Pi, Cursor CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and 20+ CLIs) powered by Rust, longbridge/nsh, and libghostty-vt

Built-in inline Git diff review, Timeline-first Insights, XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted secret vaults, and simultaneous multi-host Linux canband connections with Tailscale WhoIs auto-auth, yamux/1 per-device tokens, on-demand Tailnet discovery, SSH tunnels, and offline editing with 3-way sync

zh.website_desc: Canban（canban.dev）官方网站 — 面向 AI 编程 Agent 的开源原生 macOS / Linux 看板与持久化终端工作台（Canban = Kanban + Workflow + Herdr）。
zh.software_desc: Canban 是基于 Rust 与 libghostty-vt 构建的开源原生 macOS 和 Linux 看板及终端工作台，集成了结构化 Kanban 卡片、全局注意力收件箱（⌘I）、带独立 Git Worktree 与串行 FIFO Queue Merge 的类 GitHub Actions 工作流、行级 Diff 审查，以及支持本机与远程 Linux canband 主机的 Herdr 持久化 PTY 终端。
zh.application_sub_category: AI 编程 Agent 看板与原生持久化终端工作台
zh.software_requirements: git、Herdr Core (hc)、Linux 桌面需 GTK4 运行库，以及任意原生 Agent CLI（Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity agy、Pi、Cursor CLI、Gemini CLI、OpenCode 等）
feature_list: 灵活的 Kanban 看板：集成 Markdown 规格、#Card 关联、截图、@Agent 讨论、单卡隔离 Git Worktree 与 GitHub Issue/PR 同步
类 GitHub Actions 的 YAML 工作流与 Visual Studio：支持 Shell 脚本、Agent 步骤、Cron 定时任务与串行 FIFO Queue Merge
全局注意力收件箱（⌘I）：跨项目、本地与远程主机捕获等待输入、审批或审查的 Agent 并一键直达卡片与实时 TTY
基于 Rust、longbridge/nsh、libghostty-vt 与 Herdr 持久 PTY 原生运行 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity agy、Pi、Cursor CLI、Gemini CLI、OpenCode 等 24 种内置 CLI
内置行级 Git Diff 审查、时间线优先 Insights、XChaCha20-Poly1305 加密密钥库，以及通过 Tailscale WhoIs 自动认证、yamux/1 每设备 Token、按需 Tailnet 发现、SSH 隧道与离线三方同步同时连接多台远程 Linux canband 主机
